policies.title: Namibian ordinary passports: Grenada visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked nationality schedule lists Namibia as not requiring a visa.
conditions: Applies to a Namibian ordinary passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The active Embassy schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.
Work, study, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Namibian ordinary passports: Panama visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy nationality schedule lists Namibia in its No Visa Required cohort.
conditions: Applies to a Namibian ordinary passport holder travelling as a short visitor for up to three months.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Namibian ordinary passports: Türkiye electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Türkiye's current Foreign Ministry schedule makes Namibian ordinary passports eligible for an eVisa from 5 May 2025, delivered electronically before travel.
conditions: Applies to a Namibian ordinary passport holder travelling for tourism or trade; the eVisa portal does not cover work or residence.
Türkiye's official eVisa portal requires application information and payment before it emails the download link.
The source states Namibian ordinary-passport eVisa availability from 5 May 2025; final admission remains outside scope.

application.label: Türkiye eVisa application
steps: Start an application using the ordinary Namibian passport details and travel dates.
Enter the required information and pay electronically by an accepted card.
Download the eVisa from the emailed link before travel and retain a copy for arrival.
